wcq_confederations.qualification_summary: AFC used five qualifying rounds. Rounds 1 and 2 also served as 2027 AFC Asian Cup qualification. The top two in each third-round group qualified directly; third/fourth-place teams moved to the fourth round; fourth-round group winners qualified; fourth-round runners-up played a fifth-round tie for the AFC inter-confederation playoff place. Iraq then won the inter-confederation playoff final to become AFC's ninth qualifier.

wcq_rounds.description: Twenty teams ranked 27-46 played home-and-away over two legs. Ten winners advanced to Round 2.
Thirty-six teams were split into nine groups of four. Group winners and runners-up advanced to Round 3.
Eighteen teams were split into three groups of six. Top two in each group qualified for the World Cup; third/fourth went to Round 4.
Six teams were split into two centralized groups of three. Group winners qualified; runners-up advanced to Round 5.
The fourth-round group runners-up played over two legs for AFC's inter-confederation playoff place.
Iraq entered the FIFA Play-Off Tournament and beat Bolivia 2-1 to secure the final World Cup berth.
